instructions: Move the cube from {destination_mat} onto the table {%dir} {source_mat}, then transfer the cube from {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Judge left and right from in front of the robot, facing it.
Free {destination_mat} by placing its occupant on the table {%dir} {source_mat}; put the original occupant of {source_mat} on the freed mat. Use the camera's left and right.

The cube initially on {source_mat} belongs on {destination_mat}; the cube initially on {destination_mat} belongs on the table {%dir} {source_mat}. Left and right are as seen from in front of the robot.

First park the occupant of {destination_mat} {%dir} {source_mat} on the bare table. Then move the occupant of {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Interpret directions from in front of the robot, facing it.
Transfer the cube on {source_mat} to {destination_mat}, making room by moving the latter mat's original cube onto the table {%dir} {source_mat}. Use camera-view left and right.
Leave {destination_mat} holding the cube that began on {source_mat}, and leave its former occupant on the table {%dir} {source_mat}. Directions are viewed from in front of the robot, facing it.

Clear {destination_mat} first: move the cube resting there onto the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}. Next, carry the cube originally on {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Read left and right from in front of the robot, facing it.

Please place the original occupant of {destination_mat} on the table {%dir} {source_mat}, then move the original occupant of {source_mat} onto the now-empty {destination_mat}. Use camera-view left and right.

The cube that starts on {source_mat} should end up on {destination_mat}. Before moving it, set the cube that starts on {destination_mat} on the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}. Judge directions while facing the robot from in front.

First, take the block off {destination_mat} and park it on the table {%dir} {source_mat}. Second, relocate the block from {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Interpret left and right in the camera view.

Make space on {destination_mat} by setting its cube down on the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}; afterward, fill that space with the cube from {source_mat}. Left and right are those of a viewer standing in front of the robot and facing it.
Empty {destination_mat} onto the table {%dir} {source_mat}, moving only its cube. Then put the cube from {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Use the camera's left and right.

Please begin with the cube on {destination_mat}: leave it on the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}. Follow by placing the cube on {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Directions are as seen from in front of the robot, facing it.

Park the destination's occupant before transferring the source's occupant: take the cube from {destination_mat} to the table {%dir} {source_mat}, then take the cube from {source_mat} to {destination_mat}. Use camera-view directions.

Leave the original cube from {destination_mat} on the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}, and then leave the original cube from {source_mat} on {destination_mat}. Determine left and right from in front of the robot, looking toward it.

Your first move is to place the cube occupying {destination_mat} on the table {%dir} {source_mat}. Your next move is to place the cube occupying {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Left and right follow the camera view.

Relocate the block on {destination_mat} to a bare-table position {%dir} {source_mat}. Once that mat is clear, move the block on {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. View directions from in front of the robot, facing it.

To give the cube from {source_mat} a place on {destination_mat}, first remove the latter's cube to the table {%dir} {source_mat}. Then complete the transfer onto {destination_mat}. Use the camera's left and right.

Carry out these moves in order: place the occupant of {destination_mat} on the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}; transfer the occupant of {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Interpret left and right as a person facing the robot from in front would.

The final arrangement should have the former occupant of {source_mat} on {destination_mat} and the former occupant of {destination_mat} on the table {%dir} {source_mat}. Establish the table placement first, then transfer the source cube. Use camera-view left and right.

Start by lifting the cube from {destination_mat} and setting it on the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}. After that, lift the cube from {source_mat} and set it onto {destination_mat}. Judge directions from in front of the robot, facing it.

Could you first clear {destination_mat} by moving its block onto the table {%dir} {source_mat}, and then move the block from {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}? Use left and right as shown in the camera view.

Put the cube from {destination_mat} on the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}; only after that, put the cube from {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Left and right are viewed from in front of the robot, facing it.

Prepare {destination_mat} to receive the cube from {source_mat}: move its current occupant onto the table {%dir} {source_mat}, then place the source cube on {destination_mat}. Use camera-view left and right.

Begin with the destination mat's cube, not the source mat's: move the occupant of {destination_mat} onto the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}. Then transfer the occupant of {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Interpret directions while standing in front of and facing the robot.

Once you have parked the cube from {destination_mat} on the table {%dir} {source_mat}, place the cube from {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Perform the parking move first. Use the camera's left and right.

Move the block off {destination_mat} to the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}, freeing the mat for the block currently on {source_mat}. Then move that source block onto {destination_mat}. Read directions from in front of the robot, facing it.

Please leave {destination_mat} occupied by the cube that began on {source_mat}. To do so, first park its original cube on the table {%dir} {source_mat}, then transfer the source cube onto the cleared mat. Use camera-view directions.

Step one: set the cube from {destination_mat} down on the bare table {%dir} {source_mat}. Step two: set the cube from {source_mat} down on {destination_mat}. Left and right are as seen by someone in front of the robot, facing it.

Vacate {destination_mat} by placing its occupant on the table {%dir} {source_mat}. With that done, move the original occupant of {source_mat} onto {destination_mat}. Take left and right from the camera view.
notes: Combines freeing an occupied destination with a mat-to-mat transfer and relational parking of the displaced occupant beside the source mat.
